description: Full-text search of commitfest entries (title first, then people), the current commitfest unless commitfests. "phrase", -term, or. Each: cf_id, title, status, commitfest(s), people, last update, patch url, thread link, and outlook (the commit model: p_cf, p_release, bands low/medium/high, health; or null). Operators: intitle:, from:, after:/before:, /regex/, commitfest:, release:. A commit SHA returns the entries of its Discussion: threads, in every commitfest, and commit. Details: get_entry; cite the patch url.

query.description: e.g. NUMA, "Tom Lane". commitfest:this|next|<name> and release:this|next|PG20 keep entries the commit model gives to it

sort.description: relevance (default), likely or unlikely (by P(commit), the release's with release:; no estimate last)

name: search_commitfest
